summary: Paxton opened a state Attorney General probe into pro-Palestinian walkouts at Plano ISD, called for firing educators who facilitated anti-Israel rhetoric, and framed it as antisemitism enforcement. In October 2026 he vowed to “never stop standing with Israel and the Jewish people.” Vote for Peace rated him Opposed in the general election. His July 2026 comment questioning billions sent to “foreign countries, including Israel” was a broad foreign-aid critique rather than a targeted challenge to US-Israel policy.
